decisions.statement: A page saying where the file it holds is reached has that file linked there.
The file linked is the one the page holds its body in.
Every page saying so is weighed rather than only the pages a change moved.
A link already naming that file is left as it is.
A link naming anything else is taken away and made again.
Something there that is no link is left as it is and said as wrong.
A body that is not there is said as wrong rather than linked to.
A placing a page states for another kind of machine is not made.
A page naming no kind of machine is placed on every kind.
The home a tilde opens onto is the one handed in.
Two pages naming one link place that link once.
A link that could not be placed is said rather than thrown.
The path a link is placed at is read off the page rather than off a table here.
Nothing here writes a file inside the repository.
Nothing here says a link already naming what the page says.
A repository with no index has nothing weighed.
A placing said anywhere, not only under the home, is made here.
A placing is made here whatever rights that placing needs.
Which page types state a placing is read off the pages rather than a table here.

definition: the file a page holds linked where that page says the file is reached from
